info.name: Alloy Automation Embedded & Unified Connectivity Passthrough API

params.name: credentialId
params.description: The end-user credential ID to authenticate the request with.

items.docs: Makes a raw, authenticated request to a third-party API using a stored credentialId. Alloy attaches the provider auth and refreshes tokens; you supply the provider's native request path, method, headers, and body.
